# Undo an accidental workspace restore

## What & Why
A confirmed restore immediately replaces the profile, answer library, and application queue. Users need a short recovery path if they confirm an older backup by mistake.

## Done looks like
- The restore flow keeps the replaced workspace available for a short, clearly labeled undo window.
- Choosing Undo restores all three replaced areas together, including unsaved profile context where applicable.
- The undo state survives navigation within the app and expires clearly.
